from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator
from qiskit_algorithms import QAOA
from qiskit_optimization import QuadraticProgram
from qiskit_optimization.translators import from_docplex_mp
from qiskit_optimization.converters import QuadraticProgramToQubo
from qiskit_optimization.algorithms import MinimumEigenOptimizer
from qiskit_optimization.translators import to_docplex_mp
from qiskit_optimization.translators import to_qubo
import networkx as nx
import numpy as np

def solve_mis_qaoa(graph_vertices, graph_edges, optimal_independent_set_size, p_layers=2, penalty=2.0, opt_shots=512, final_shots=4096, maxiter=80, seed=42):
    # Create the graph
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(graph_edges)

    # Define the quadratic program
    qp = QuadraticProgram()
    x = qp.binary_var_list(len(graph_vertices))
    for i in range(len(graph_vertices)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(graph_vertices)):
            if G.has_edge(graph_vertices[i], graph_vertices[j]):
                qp.linear_obj_coeff(x[i], penalty)
                qp.linear_obj_coeff(x[j], penalty)
                qp.quadratic_obj_coeff(x[i], x[j], -1)

    # Convert to QUBO
    qubo_converter = QuadraticProgramToQubo()
    qubo_problem = qubo_converter.convert(qp)

    # Set up QAOA
    backend = AerSimulator(seed_simulator=seed)
    qaoa = QAOA(backend, optimizer=None, p=p_layers)

    # Solve the problem
    optimizer = MinimumEigenOptimizer(qaoa)
    result = optimizer.solve(qubo_problem)

    # Extract the solution
    solution = result.x
    independent_set = [graph_vertices[i] for i in range(len(graph_vertices)) if solution[i] == 1]

    # Calculate metrics
    independent_set_ratio = len(independent_set) / optimal_independent_set_size
    validity_rate = 1.0 if nx.is_independent_set(G, independent_set) else 0.0
    embedding_overhead = len(solution)  # Simplified assumption
    resource_cost = len(solution) * p_layers  # Simplified assumption

    return {
        'independent_set_ratio': independent_set_ratio,
        'validity_rate': validity_rate,
        'embedding_overhead': embedding_overhead,
        'resource_cost': resource_cost
    }

# Example usage
graph_vertices = ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6", "R7", "R8"]
graph_edges = [
    ["R1", "R2"], ["R2", "R3"], ["R3", "R4"],
    ["R5", "R6"], ["R6", "R7"], ["R7", "R8"],
    ["R1", "R5"], ["R2", "R6"], ["R3", "R7"], ["R4", "R8"]
]
optimal_independent_set_size = 4

result = solve_mis_qaoa(graph_vertices, graph_edges, optimal_independent_set_size)
print(result)
